events.message: Rollout complete. Ignition countdown armed.
Ignition. Flight director controls the first 100 metres.
100 metres. Flight controls are yours. Guidance is optional; staging remains manual.
Custom core stage separated. 48,346 kg released.
Bound Earth orbit confirmed. Plan lunar departure when ready.
Waiting for the aligned lunar departure window. Coast time can be accelerated.
Lunar departure burn. Prograde guidance uses engine thrust and finite propellant.
Upper propellant depleted. Separate the upper stage to continue.
Upper stage released. 14299 kg discarded; spacecraft engine available.
Departure cutoff. Coasting toward the moving Moon; no engine or fuel is needed to coast.
Lunar sphere of influence. Coordinates changed; world position and velocity are continuous.
Lunar periapsis targeted. Engine cutoff; ballistic approach to capture.
Lunar capture burn. Braking into a bound local orbit.
Lunar orbit established. Coasting to the selected landing approach.
Powered descent begins. Braking orbital motion toward the chosen pad.
Terminal descent. Cancel lateral drift and follow the selected pad.
